model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the changes in three different sparsity ratios over a range of values on the x-axis. The x-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 14 in increments of 2. The y-axis is also unlabeled but has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2.

The graph contains three distinct lines, each representing a different sparsity ratio. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," starts at approximately 0.25 on the y-axis and decreases to around 0.05 as it moves along the x-axis, with a relatively stable trend after the initial drop. The orange dotted line, representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," begins at 1.0 on the y-axis and decreases to around 0.4 before rising to approximately 0.6 towards the end of the x-axis range. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," starts at 1.0 on the y-axis and decreases to around 0.3, with a slight increase before stabilizing and then decreasing again.

Overall, the graph shows a comparison of the three sparsity ratios across the range of x-values, with each line exhibiting distinct trends and patterns.
model_annotations.Chinese: 图显示了三个不同的稀疏率随某个未指定参数的变化。x轴和y轴均为线性刻度，x轴范围从0到大约10，y轴范围从0到1。图表中有三条线：一条橙色虚线，一条绿色点划线和一条蓝色虚线。橙色虚线表示“门控后的稀疏率，平均0.44”，起始于大约0.95，下降到大约0.6，然后在0.5到0.7之间波动，在x=9时达到峰值0.7。绿色点划线表示“平均门控后的稀疏率，平均0.33”，起始于大约0.95，下降到大约0.3，然后在0.25到0.35之间波动。蓝色虚线表示“稀疏率，平均0.03”，起始于大约0.25，下降到大约0.05，然后保持稳定直到x=10。
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio after different gates, comparing the effects of various gate operations on the sparsity ratio. The x-axis is unlabeled, has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 10 with tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis is also unlabeled but has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are shown in the plot: a blue dashed line representing 'sparsity ratio before gate' with an average value of 0.05, which starts at approximately 0.25 and decreases to around 0.05; an orange dotted line representing 'sparsity ratio after gate' with an average value of 0.44, starting at 1.0 and decreasing to around 0.4 before rising to approximately 0.6; and a green dash-dot line representing 'sparsity ratio after average gate' with an average value of 0.33, beginning at 1.0 and decreasing to around 0.2.
model_annotations.German: The diagram displays the sparsity ratio before and after different gate operations, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis and y-axis represent unspecified variables, with the x-axis ranging from 0 to an unknown value and the y-axis ranging from 0 to approximately 0.9. The diagram features three lines: a dotted orange line representing the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", a dash-dotted green line representing the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", and a dashed blue line representing the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.09". The dotted orange line starts at approximately (0, 0.9) and decreases to around (3, 0.4) before fluctuating between 0.3 and 0.5. The dash-dotted green line begins at a similar point, (0, 0.9), and decreases more sharply to around (2, 0.3), then stabilizes between 0.2 and 0.3 before decreasing again. The dashed blue line starts at approximately (0, 0.2) and remains relatively stable, ranging from 0.05 to 0.1.
